backfold: A correction at the second event branches from the original timeline to a revised summary below.
streamsieve: Three telemetry channels enter a brief. A selected channel retains a handle back to its samples.
chronosieve: A series shifts from one level to another. A blue bracket marks the changed interval for a digest.
causalsieve: Three aligned telemetry channels shift at different times. The earlier upstream candidate is highlighted for investigation.
flashmp: Two repeated subsequences align across an observed series. Blue brackets identify their locations.
tsjit: A fixed context window feeds a forecast with a fixed horizon. The blue continuation is the prediction.
recastcrps: An ensemble member shifts relative to the observation. The remaining forecast members keep their positions.
